articles.title: New Ownership of PostalAnnex in Kerman, California Brings Fresh Energy to the Business--Serving the Community with Shipping and Office Services for Nearly 30 Years
articles.mainIdea: New Ownership of PostalAnnex in Kerman, California Brings Fresh Energy to the Business--Serving the Community with Shipping and Office Services for Nearly 30 Years
articles.summary: PR Newswire: New Ownership of PostalAnnex in Kerman, California Brings Fresh Energy to the Business--Serving the Community with Shipping and Office Services for Nearly 30 Years. Annex Brands, Inc., a leading franchisor in the packing, shipping, and office services industries, is pleased to announce the successful transfer of ownership of an existing PostalAnnex location in Kerman, CA to new owner, Helen Shergill-Barandalla. This transition to new ownership ensures that the community will benefit from the essential Shipping and Office Services provided by this PostalAnnex for nearly 30 years. Related tickers mentioned: FDX, UPS.

articles.title: Mayor of Plano, U.S., Visits SK Signet Headquarters to Strengthen North American EV Charging Infrastructure Partnership
articles.mainIdea: Mayor of Plano, U.S., Visits SK Signet Headquarters to Strengthen North American EV Charging Infrastructure Partnership
articles.summary: PR Newswire: Mayor of Plano, U.S., Visits SK Signet Headquarters to Strengthen North American EV Charging Infrastructure Partnership. SK Signet (KONEX: 260870), a global manufacturer of high-power EV charging solutions based in South Korea, announced on April 2nd that the Mayor of Plano, Texas, and an official delegation visited its headquarters and the R&D center.
